name: ditfa-code
description: The AI coding agent that shows its work. Tab autocomplete, any model, your own keys or a Ditfa plan, review and undo every change hunk by hunk, checkpoints without Git, and a sandbox the engine enforces.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Ditfa Code executes commands and edits files in the workspace, which requires trust.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Ditfa Code runs commands and edits files on disk.

commands.title: Turn Tab Autocomplete On or Off

ditfa.executablePath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `ditfa` executable. Leave empty to auto-detect (bundled binary, then `PATH`, then a local Cargo build).

ditfa.ditfaHome.markdownDescription: Override `DITFA_HOME` (defaults to `~/.ditfa`). Determines where `config.toml`, credentials, and thread history live.

ditfa.provider.markdownDescription: Model provider: `ditfa`, `openai`, `anthropic`, `gemini`, `openrouter`, `deepseek`, `ollama`, `lmstudio`, or any id from `config.toml`. Empty uses the engine default.

ditfa.model.description: Model to use. Empty uses the provider default.

enumDescriptions: Use the model default
Minimal reasoning
Low reasoning
Medium reasoning
High reasoning
Extra-high reasoning
ditfa.reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort for models that support it.

enumDescriptions: Ask before running anything not on the trusted list
Ask only when the agent requests escalation
Never ask (relies entirely on the sandbox)
ditfa.approvalPolicy.description: When Ditfa asks before acting. The mode menu in the chat panel sets this.

enumDescriptions: The agent can read files but not write or run network commands
The agent can write inside the workspace
No sandbox — the agent has full access to the machine
ditfa.sandboxMode.description: Sandbox the engine applies to the agent. The mode menu in the chat panel sets this.

ditfa.allowNetwork.description: Let sandboxed commands reach the network, for example to install packages.

ditfa.maxTokensPerTurn.markdownDescription: Stop a turn once it has used this many tokens. `0` turns the limit off.

ditfa.completion.enabled.markdownDescription: Suggest code as you type; press `Tab` to accept. Suggestions use the provider set in **Ditfa: Set Up Tab Autocomplete** (your Ditfa plan, an API key, or a local model); nothing is sent until one is set.

ditfa.completion.provider.markdownDescription: Provider for Tab autocomplete. Empty follows the chat provider. A fast, cheap provider works best here, and a local one keeps code on your machine.

ditfa.completion.model.markdownDescription: Model for Tab autocomplete. Pick a small, fast one: suggestions should arrive in about a second. Empty uses the chat model, or a code model a local server has loaded.

ditfa.completion.debounceMs.markdownDescription: How long to wait after you stop typing before asking for a suggestion.

ditfa.completion.maxTokens.markdownDescription: The longest a suggestion may be, in tokens.

ditfa.completion.multiline.markdownDescription: Allow suggestions that run over several lines. A suggestion never runs past the current line when code follows the cursor on it.

ditfa.completion.contextFiles.markdownDescription: Include short excerpts of your other open files so suggestions can match them. Files that look like secrets, such as `.env` and key files, are never used.

ditfa.completion.disabledLanguages.markdownDescription: Language ids Tab autocomplete stays quiet in.

ditfa.showReasoning.description: Show the model's reasoning summary in the chat transcript.

ditfa.autoContext.activeFile.description: Automatically attach the active file path as context with each message.

ditfa.logLevel.description: Verbosity of the Ditfa Code output channel.

ditfa.env.markdownDescription: Extra environment variables for the `ditfa` process. API keys belong in the panel's provider setup, which stores them in your system keychain; these are plain text.

enumDescriptions: Remember the last mode chosen in the chat
Answer and explain; never edits files
Write a step-by-step plan first, then implement it when you say so
Edit files and run commands to finish the task
ditfa.chatMode.markdownDescription: How Ditfa works on each message. Leave empty to keep the mode last picked in the chat.

enumDescriptions: Messages sent while Ditfa is working wait in a queue and go out one by one
Messages sent while Ditfa is working are added to the current turn
ditfa.queueBehavior.markdownDescription: What `Enter` does while a turn is running. The other choice is always on `Cmd/Ctrl+Enter`.

enumDescriptions: Notify after every finished turn
Notify only when the editor or the chat is not in focus
Never notify
ditfa.notifyOnComplete.description: Show a notification when Ditfa finishes a task.

ditfa.chime.description: Play a short sound when Ditfa finishes or needs your approval.

ditfa.quickFix.preview.markdownDescription: Show **Fix with Ditfa** changes in the refactor preview before applying them.

ditfa.voice.language.markdownDescription: Language for dictation and voice replies, as a BCP-47 tag such as `en`, `de` or `fa`. Empty follows the editor's display language.

ditfa.voice.voice.description: The voice Ditfa speaks with in voice mode.

enumDescriptions: Pick the first microphone source that works
Record in the chat panel
Record with sox or ffmpeg on this machine
Record in a small local browser page

ditfa.voice.handsFree.description: In voice mode, keep listening after each reply and stop when you go quiet.

ditfa.voice.autoSendDictation.description: Send dictated text right away instead of leaving it in the message box.

enumDescriptions: Voice requests go to the coding agent, which answers with a spoken summary
Voice requests go to a quick spoken assistant that does not edit files
Models answer independently, critique each other anonymously, rank, and the leader writes the result
The leader splits the task and each part goes to the model best suited for it
ditfa.roundtable.defaultMode.description: How a new round table works.

ditfa.roundtable.participants.markdownDescription: Models that sit at the round table by default, as `provider/model` ids. Empty picks a diverse set from the models you can use.

ditfa.roundtable.maxRounds.description: Most critique rounds in review mode; the table stops earlier when nobody changes their answer.

ditfa.roundtable.leader.markdownDescription: Model that leads the round table. `auto` picks the strongest participant.

ditfa.featureModels.markdownDescription: Model used for each feature, such as `{"completion": "ditfa/fast", "voice": "ditfa/voice"}`. Easier to set in **Ditfa: Open Settings Panel**.

scripts.package: pnpm run build && pnpm run check-bundle && vsce package --no-dependencies
